subject: Novamed tenant activation: API keys, invites, and rollout checkpoints
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Johnson <ejohnson@novamed.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novamed tenant activation — initial questions and invite counts

Hi Emma,

Great to get Novamed across the finish line. Monica will lead the implementation and Dev will handle API provisioning. A few quick items to confirm so we can schedule the activation window: 

- How many users should we create as initial admin/engineer seats (Redwood Console invites)?
- Do you want separate projects for prod/staging or a single project with env tags?
- Any constraints on where keys are delivered (SFTP, secure email, or paste into your secret manager)?
- Procurement/PO contact so we can trigger billing/accounting (CC included if needed).

If we can lock these by end of day tomorrow we can target the activation on Friday 3/19. I attached a short invite template that Monica will use for invites.

Thanks — Laura
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachment: novamed-invite-template.csv
From: Emma Johnson <ejohnson@novamed.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Kurt Miller <kurt.miller@novamed.com>, procurement@novamed.com
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novamed tenant activation — initial questions and invite counts

Hi Laura — thanks. Quick answers: 

- Start with 4 admin/engineer seats (2 infra, 2 app). We will add end users later.
- Please set up separate projects for staging and production. We prefer strict separation.
- Deliver keys to our security inbox (procurement@novamed.com) and also post to our Vault path (I will share write access temporarily).
- Procurement is CC'd — they will confirm purchase order details separately.

One more ask: can we get staging (non-prod) keys first so our devs can smoke test before prod flip? Aim for staging keys by Thursday morning.

—Emma
Head of Engineering, Novamed
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Johnson <ejohnson@novamed.com>, Kurt Miller <kurt.miller@novamed.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Implementation checklist & access mapping — Novamed activation

Emma / Kurt — thanks for the fast responses. Below is a pragmatic checklist I will follow; please reply inline where you want changes. Attaching our short playbook with naming conventions.

Implementation checklist (targets):
1) Projects: create two projects in your account — novamed-prod and novamed-staging.
2) Service account emails: send the exact mailbox(es) we should add as service principals so we can mint scoped API keys. (format: name@yourdomain).
3) Invite list: 4 initial seats (2 infra, 2 app) — provide full names + emails for invites; we will send console invites and a short onboarding note.
4) Staging keys: Redwood will provision short-lived staging keys (scoped to staging project) by Thursday 2027-03-18 10:00 PT for smoke tests.
5) Prod keys: issuance after successful staging verification and a brief runbook sign-off (expected Friday 2027-03-19).
6) Security controls: if you want IP allowlists or key-restriction to specific endpoints, tell us now — otherwise keys will be scoped to project + role.

Attached: redwood-api-key-playbook.pdf (includes suggested least-privilege roles, key naming convention, and the invite CSV you can fill). Also attached is the invite template Laura shared.

Action items for Novamed (reply here):
- Share service account email(s) for key minting
- Confirm the 4 invite emails to populate the CSV
- Confirm Vault path and that procurement@novamed.com can receive keys securely

I'll provision staging keys as soon as we get service account emails.

Thanks — Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0170
Attachment: redwood-api-key-playbook.pdf, novamed-invite-template.csv
From: Kurt Miller <kurt.miller@novamed.com>

Cc: Emma Johnson <ejohnson@novamed.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation checklist & access mapping — Novamed activation

Monica — thanks for the clear checklist (copied below). A few clarifications from our side: 

- Service account: please mint keys against the service principal novamed-infra-sa@novamed.com. I will grant the account minimal roles for the staging project.
- Key restrictions: we do want to restrict keys to the staging project and to our IP ranges for extra safety. I will provide the CIDR ranges before noon.
- Staging keys timeline: Thursday 10:00 PT works. Please mark keys as expiring in 7 days for staging so we avoid accidental prod use.

On the quoting for prod keys, procurement will come back with the PO ID later today.

Dev — quick internal note and confirmation to close the loop:

- Service account to use: novamed-infra-sa@novamed.com (as Kurt confirmed).
- Scope: create staging key scoped to novamed-staging project + IP allowlist (Kurt to provide CIDRs). Expiry: 7 days.
- Deliverable: staging key, delivered to procurement@novamed.com and posted to the Vault path they grant us. I will notify when done.
- Invite list: Laura to confirm names/emails and we will send console invites by 12:00 PT.
- Runbook: I uploaded the short sign-off checklist to the Drive link (see metadata). After Kurt thumbs-up on staging, we issue prod keys on Friday.

Please provision the key in our key-management portal (use playbook naming: redwood-novamed-staging-20270318) and mark the secret as temporary. Ping me when ready and I will post and notify Novamed.

Monica Patel
